_comment: Example hub-home config.json: the delegation dial and subagent rules of a user whose sessions run at a high
effort and who does not want subagents to inherit it. Merge the keys into <hub home>/config.json.
Policy: the smallest model (Haiku) runs freely at any type; every other model runs only through an agent
definition that pins effort (the plugin's delamain:worker-* or your own) and with an explicit model;
xhigh and max are not pinned for them, except Sonnet, which runs only at high or xhigh, never lower;
a fork (which ignores `model`) is denied; headless `agent spawn` only refuses Sonnet below high;
level 0 of the dial denies the Agent and Workflow tools (the built-in delegation rule).
Haiku has an effort setting (Haiku 5.5), and a Haiku subagent without a pinned effort inherits the session's:
so Haiku runs at high (the default of `agent spawn`), medium is allowed, low is denied.

AGENT_HUB_EFFORT_RULES.reason: A fork ignores `model` and runs at the parent's model and effort: use subagent_type delamain:worker-medium / delamain:worker-high with an explicit model, or model "haiku" for mechanical work.
Haiku runs at high, medium at the least (asked for {effort}): subagent_type delamain:worker-medium / delamain:worker-high with model "haiku", or `agent spawn --effort high`.
Sonnet runs only at high or xhigh (asked for {effort}).
Sonnet runs only at high or xhigh: subagent_type delamain:worker-high or delamain:worker-xhigh with model "sonnet" (got {subagent_type} at effort {effort}).

A subagent other than Haiku must run through a definition that pins a moderate effort, or it inherits the session's: use subagent_type delamain:worker-medium / delamain:worker-high with an explicit model; mechanical work (search, logs, Explore) with model "haiku" (type {subagent_type}, effort {effort}, model {model}).
Name the model explicitly (the `model` parameter or `model:` in the definition) — an inherited model is the session's (type {subagent_type}).
